children: Freeport Indonesia, an affiliate of US miner Freeport-McMoRan
, is offering copper from its Manyar smelter to Chinese buyers at a premium of $158 per metric ton for 2027, said two market sources with knowledge of the matter.
Freeport and Freeport Indonesia did not respond immediately to requests for comment.
